description:
Wire shape for a `MessageDisplay` hook invocation's stdin JSON payload.

Unlike every other command hook, `MessageDisplay` has no corresponding output-wire type: it is fire-and-forget (see `hooks/src/legacy_notify.rs` for the execution precedent) and never parses a decision back from the child process, so there is nothing to schema-generate for its output.

displayed_text.description: Cumulative text for this item so far, not a delta.

is_final.description: `true` for the last delivery for this `item_id`.

turn_id.description: Codex extension: expose the active turn id to internal turn-scoped hooks.

title: message-display.command.input
